thread:
maya: heads up — starting bring-up of model v4-int4 on staging. latency looks great but we're seeing a small nDCG dip on long-doc slices. proposing a multimetric canary instead of single-metric gating.

raj: can you sketch thresholds?

maya: quick proposal: 
- canary window: 30m
- metrics: nDCG@10 (relative), hallucination_rate (relative), p95_latency_ms (absolute), embed_sim_delta (relative)
- auto-fallback if metric violations persist (sliding window)

olga: defs? what counts as a "violation" and how noisy are these long-doc slices?

maya: thinking concrete numbers: 
```
canary:
  duration: 30m
  metrics:
    - name: nDCG@10
      threshold: -1.5%  # allowed relative drop vs baseline
    - name: hallucination_rate
      threshold: +0.5%  # allowed relative increase
    - name: p95_latency_ms
      threshold: 250     # absolute ms
    - name: embed_sim_delta
      threshold: -0.01   # small similarity drop
  auto_fallback:
    window: 10m
    violations: 3        # 3 windows with any metric breaching => immediate rollback
```

maya: also require min_sample: 200 requests per window and use EWMA smoothing over 2 windows to avoid flapping.

sam: rollout increments? how quickly do we move to prod if all green?

maya: staged steps: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. hold at 5% for at least 1 hour to watch long-doc regressions. enable shadow-compare for long-doc corpus during 1% and 5% phases.

raj: infra note — need to ensure kv-cache warmup for int4 path; coldstarts blow up p95. i'll add a warmup hook to the canary.

olga: add circuit-breaker: if p95 > 2x baseline for two consecutive 5m buckets, immediate rollback and alert SRE. Also attach a runbook link.

maya: agreed. i'll add a polish: require both quality and safety to be within thresholds for promotion; latency alone can't promote us if hallucination_rate increases.

raj: how do we trigger the smoke? command?

maya: use the new promote CLI: `rwdctl promote --model v4-int4 --canary --policy infra/canary-v4-int4.yaml`

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary promotion scheduled by maya for staging at 2024-05-12T10:00:00Z

sam: :eyes: can we also capture per-slice deltas in the console dashboard? want to watch "long-docs" and "rationale" slices specifically.

maya: yes — will add per-slice rows and a small eval job that runs every 15m against the holdout prompts.

olga: one more ask — include hysteresis: require 2 consecutive green windows before stepping traffic. reduces oscillation.

maya: good call. will implement hysteresis and the circuit-breaker. plan: run mini-sweep tomorrow, then a promoted canary on Thursday. pinging @raj for the cache warmup hook and @olga for runbook review. :thumbsup:

raj: on it.

olga: reading runbook now. small nits but nothing blocking.

maya: thanks — will push canary config to infra repo and link here when ready.
